geometry: Square two-dimensional patterned slab; fixed original Legume gmax2.1 spatial basis
threshold_physics: One retained native mode below and one above the zero-order light cone; actual 0 -> 4 outgoing channel change

quadrature.scope: Finite-window integral only; no spectral-tail or QNM completion

metadata.coordinate_contract: Scaled displacement u: physical D=sum_i omega_i D_i u_i; native H-mode coefficient=i du_i/dt under matching units. Not a direct time-varying-H coefficient equation.
metadata.density_role: Weak-radiation real-axis density evaluated with fixed native spatial modes
metadata.negative_frequency: Measured native H(-k)^* = H(k) T; Gamma(-nu,+k)=T Gamma(nu,-k)^* T^H

reality_map_metadata.normalization_contract: Native full-space modal coordinates are orthonormal; sampled window may have nonidentity Gram but must support a unitary pointwise field map
reality_map_metadata.scope: signed real-axis Gram/power map only, no complex retarded continuation

metadata.material_reality_contract: K(+k,tau) = T K(-k,tau)^* T^H; no same-k constraint away from Gamma
metadata.loss_ownership: One memory bath only; material has no damping and no frozen gamma added
metadata.reactive_reference: Unsubtracted causal finite-window integral; native bare GME stiffness; no fitted counterterm
metadata.outside_window: Density set to zero as an explicit model truncation, not asserted physically zero
metadata.system_bath_modulation: Bath is stationary; only projected physical permittivity is time modulated

limitations: Only the declared native spatial/modal subspace is represented; no full Maxwell-space convergence claim
Finite spectral tails are zero by model definition; their physical values remain unknown
Positive eta smooths the light-cone onset and can create residual damping below threshold
Stationary bath coupling, fixed reference channels and weak-radiation density; no QNM metric or actual external R/T ports
Analytic kernel and passive finite-state algebra establish this model, not a unique Maxwell self-energy
